result.instructions: Tools for Marmin, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my sales invoices from this week and show the Peppol status of each."; "Why was invoice INV-001 rejected? Show the Peppol status log."; "Show the purchase invoices from supplier VAT number 100123456700003.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Marmin data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run marmin_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run marmin_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run marmin_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. marmin_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: marmin_list_business_profiles
tools.title: List business profiles
tools.description: List the Marmin business profiles (legal entities) of this organization, with TRN, TIN, Peppol endpoint and onboarding status. Use profile_id from the result to know which entity a document belongs to. Read-only. Limit: 30 requests/minute.

status.description: Onboarding status, for example ONBOARDED or COMPLETED.

tools.name: marmin_get_business_profile
tools.title: Get a business profile
tools.description: Get one business profile by its profile_id (for example MBP-00001): legal name, TRN, trade license, Peppol endpoint, address and onboarding status. Read-only.

tools.name: marmin_list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List tax invoices, credit notes or proforma invoices of one kind, newest first as Marmin returns them. Each item has the number, dates, type code (380 invoice, 381 credit note, 389 self-billed, 261 self-billed credit note), parties, amounts and currency. Filter by number, party name, VAT number, status or issue date. Read-only. Limit: 60 requests/minute.

kind.description: Document kind. Sales documents are issued by your business profile, purchase documents are received. Proforma invoices are quotes without a tax filing.

invoice_number.description: Credit notes only: the number of the invoice the credit note refers to.

tools.name: marmin_list_document_uuids
tools.title: List document ids created on a day
tools.description: List the ids (UUIDs) of all documents of one kind that were created on one day. Use it to find new documents day by day, then read each with marmin_get_document. Read-only.

kind.description: Document kind. Sales documents are issued by your business profile, purchase documents are received. Proforma invoices are quotes without a tax filing.

annotations.title: List document ids created on a day

tools.name: marmin_get_document
tools.title: Get a document
tools.description: Get one invoice, credit note or proforma invoice by id: parties, lines, tax breakdown, totals (also in AED) and meta_info.peppol_status (overall_status PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED or VALIDATION_FAILED, with validation_results). Read-only.

kind.description: Document kind. Sales documents are issued by your business profile, purchase documents are received. Proforma invoices are quotes without a tax filing.

id.description: Document id (UUID), as returned by marmin_list_documents.

tools.name: marmin_get_document_xml
tools.title: Get the UBL XML of a document
tools.description: Get the UAE e-invoicing XML (UBL 2.1, PINT AE) of an invoice or credit note. Long XML is cut by the server's result size limit. Read-only.

kind.description: Document kind (proforma invoices have no XML).

id.description: Document id (UUID), as returned by marmin_list_documents.

annotations.title: Get the UBL XML of a document

tools.name: marmin_get_peppol_status
tools.title: Get the Peppol status of a document
tools.description: Get the current Peppol transmission snapshot of an invoice or credit note: the billing leg (toC3, to the buyer's access point) and the tax-reporting leg (toC5, to the FTA), each with status and transmission errors, plus validation results. The XML copies are left out. Needs Phase 2 in the Marmin subscription (else HTTP 404). Read-only.

kind.description: Document kind (proforma invoices have no XML).

id.description: Document id (UUID), as returned by marmin_list_documents.

annotations.title: Get the Peppol status of a document

tools.name: marmin_get_peppol_status_log
tools.title: Get the Peppol status log of a document
tools.description: Get the time-ordered Peppol events of a sales invoice, sales credit note or purchase credit note (DOCUMENT_CREATED, DOCUMENT_SUBMITTED, VALIDATION_SUCCESS and so on) with a message each. Use it to see why a document was rejected. The XML copies are left out. Read-only.

kind.description: Document kind (purchase invoices have no status log).

id.description: Document id (UUID), as returned by marmin_list_documents.

annotations.title: Get the Peppol status log of a document

tools.name: marmin_get_register_entry
tools.title: Get a register entry
tools.description: Get one document register entry (the sales or purchase register of a business profile) by its id, including the linked document_id for e-invoices. Read-only.

tools.name: marmin_get_codelist
tools.title: Get a code list
tools.description: Get a Marmin code list: valid values for invoice fields, for example tax-categories, unit-of-measure-codes, uae-subdivisions (emirate codes), currencies, credit-note-reason-codes, payment-means-modes, tax-exemption-reason-codes. Read-only.
